package readmodel

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/goobers/goobers/internal/journal"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

// Copied into the pinned v0.4.1 source archive, not compiled with current code.
// Both SQLite decoding and projection writing are the actual released package.
func TestDiagnosticsPriorReleaseReadWrite(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("GOOBERS_ROLLBACK_FIXTURE")
	if root == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing fixture")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	store, err := Open(filepath.Join(root, FileName))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if err := store.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	row, found, err := store.GetRun(ctx, "run-0001")
	if err != nil || !found {
		t.Fatalf("read new DB found=%v err=%v", found, err)
	}
	if row.Workflow != "implementation" || row.Gaggle != "alpha" || len(row.Operator.Activity.Active) != 1 || row.Operator.Activity.Active[0].Name != "implement" {
		t.Fatalf("core facts lost: %+v", row)
	}
	run, _, err := journal.Recover(filepath.Join(root, "runs", row.RunID))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := run.Append(journal.Event{Type: journal.EventRunnerAnnotation, Runner: map[string]any{"kind": "rollback-prior-writer"}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := run.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	result, err := store.BuildFromJournals(ctx, []string{filepath.Join(root, "runs")})
	if err != nil || result.Projected != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("old projection=%+v err=%v", result, err)
	}
	written, found, err := store.GetRun(ctx, row.RunID)
	if err != nil || !found || written.LastSeq != row.LastSeq+1 {
		t.Fatalf("old writer did not advance: %+v %v", written, err)
	}
}
